title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Province of Tayabas to Quezon

title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Tỉnh Tayabas thành Quezon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อจังหวัด Tayabas เป็น Quezon
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Provinsi Tayabas menjadi Quezon
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Wilayah Tayabas kepada Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_14_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the eminent and patriotic services rendered to the country by President Quezon, the name of the Province of Tayabas is hereby changed to Quezon.
All laws inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 7, 1946
